pilot_label: Pilot 9 — Consensus RAPC v2 (Path A + B)
hypothesis_description: Pilot 8 L-198 진단: RAPC 5F FF3 retention 10.5% → style 노출 89.5%. Pilot 9: Consensus family 15종 전수 IC/ICIR/Harvey_t/FF3 retention 측정 후 FF3-independent 팩터(retention>=25%) 선별 → IC-weighted composite 구성. Path A: FF3 residualization 검토. Path B: composite 직접 설계. 선별 팩터: C04_ESBR+C19_Composite_Earnings+C01_SUE+C09_Earnings_Surprise_Sq.
